WonderSwan is a handheld video game console developed by Bandai.
First released in Japan in March 1999 and discontinued in 2003.
About 3.5 million units were sold.
Its library has 109 games.
It followed the Design Master Senshi Mangajukuu and was succeeded by the WonderSwan Color.
Processors include the NEC V30 MZ.
